prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset for a hand-painted campus escape-room game. One isolated paper-record prop on a truly transparent background, no ground plane. Gouache and soft colored-pencil illustration, tactile aged paper, muted cream, grey-green, brown and brass palette, softly lit from upper left, readable silhouette. Slight three-quarter top view, centered, whole prop visible with generous transparent margin. No readable writing, no letters, no digits, no codes or puzzle answers, no watermark, no extra loose accessories.
Subject: A soft rust-brown cloth broadcast running-order notebook open at a shallow angle with thick blank cream pages and faint unlabelled horizontal timing rows. No digits, musical notation, microphone or actual schedule text.
